realm_description: A dense, patient forest that rewards those willing to grow at nature's pace. Trust, healing, and quiet resilience all take shape here, far from the noise of the capitals.

primary.label: Healer
primary.description: Cares deeply; others' suffering is what they fear most.
primary.guiding_promise: I will ease what hurts, and protect what heals.
primary.shadow_description: Absorbs everyone else's pain until there's nothing left to tend their own.

secondary.label: Artisan
secondary.description: Pursues mastery and craft; decisions come from trained instinct.
secondary.guiding_promise: I will give every task the full weight of my ability.
secondary.shadow_description: Refuses to call the work finished, and refuses anyone else's hands on it either.

wheel.central_question: Should we optimize the system, or tend to the person?

growth.label: Artisan
growth.description: Pursues mastery and craft; decisions come from trained instinct.
growth.guiding_promise: I will give every task the full weight of my ability.
growth.shadow_description: Refuses to call the work finished, and refuses anyone else's hands on it either.

other_ally.label: Builder
other_ally.description: Driven to make things real with their own hands.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I will make something real that endures long after I am gone.
other_ally.shadow_description: Cannot put the work down long enough to notice what it has quietly cost them.

quarter.label: Ranger
quarter.description: Moves between civilization and the wild with equal ease; nature trusts them for it.
quarter.guiding_promise: I will walk lightly, so what I protect still has somewhere to stand.
quarter.shadow_description: Stays so carefully balanced between two worlds that they never fully belong to either.

opposite.label: Technocrat
opposite.description: Optimises for efficiency; people-politics is noise to filter out.
opposite.guiding_promise: I solve what others accept — with data, not drama.
opposite.shadow_description: Optimizes the system so completely that the people inside it become variables, not lives.

realmmate.label: Sage
realmmate.description: Lets truth settle slowly; offers wisdom gently to those still searching.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I will wait for the truth to settle, and share it without needing credit.
realmmate.shadow_description: Waits so long for the truth to settle that it's no longer useful by the time they speak it.

wheel.compatible_text: Sage · Historian — fellow travelers of The Living Forest.
